items.title: 14.6.1 Formation of smog (smog ka banna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.6.1 with Figures 14.3 and 14.4, printed page 312.

blocks.text: Smog air pollution ki ek type hai jis ki pehchan thick haze (ghani dhund) hai. Yeh zyada tar shehron mein hoti hai aur aksar gariyon, factories aur doosre pollution sources ke emissions (dhuen) se banti hai. Is mein bareek dhool ya soot (kalikh) ke particles, jame hue water vapour, SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO aur CO₂ jaisi poisonous (zehreeli) gases, O₃ jaise secondary pollutants, bina jale hydrocarbons, VOCs aur 10 se 2.5 micron ke PM shamil hote hain.

Sulphurous ya industrial smog ko “reducing smog ya classical smog” bhi kehte hain. Yeh aam taur par tab banti hai jab hawa mein sulphur oxides (SOₓ) ki bari amount chhori jaye. Ise London smog bhi kehte hain.

Photochemical smog mein primary air pollutants, jaise nitrogen oxides (NOₓ), VOC aur bina jale hydrocarbons, sooraj ki roshni mein photochemical reactions (light se hone wale reactions) karte hain aur secondary pollutants, jaise ozone aur peroxyacetyl nitrates (PAN), banate hain. Yeh smog zyada khatarnak samjhi jati hai kyun ke is se heart palpitations (dil ki tez aur be-tarteeb dharkan), pneumonia aur yahan tak ke lung cancer (phephron ka cancer) bhi ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen sooraj, 'Sunlight' likha hai; neeche sarak par cars, bus aur truck dhuan chhorte hue, 'Nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds' likha hai. Dhoop aur traffic se aane wali lakeerein mil kar ek teer banti hain jo bhoore badal 'Brown photochemical smog' ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.4: Photochemical smog ki picture (kitab ki Figure 14.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gariyon ke dhuen ki nitrogen oxides aur VOCs jab dhoop mein react karti hain to ozone aur PAN jaisi secondary pollutants banti hain; inhi se bhoori (brown) photochemical smog banti hai. Is liye yeh smog dhoop wale, zyada traffic wale shehron mein din ke waqt banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Photochemical smog kin conditions (halaat) mein banti hai, aur is ka bhoora rang kahan se aata hai?
blocks.explanation: Tez dhoop wale, garam aur thehri hawa wale dinon mein, jab bhari traffic ke NOₓ aur VOCs dhoop mein react kar ke ozone aur PAN banate hain. Bhoora (brown) rang NO₂ gas ki wajah se hota hai.

items: Smog: kalikh, paani ke qatre, SO₂, NOₓ, O₃, CO, CO₂, hydrocarbons, VOCs aur PM ki ghani shehri dhund.
Classical (London): SOₓ se, reducing. Photochemical (Los Angeles): dhoop mein NOₓ + VOCs se O₃ aur PAN; zyada khatarnak.
